svg.title: The pull scene (app/godot/scenes/pull.tscn): a season's events against the rivals, at a club venue

g.text: The pull scene (app/godot/scenes/pull.tscn): a season's events against the rivals, at a club venue
+driver : Callable, a scripted driver for tests
Kind: clutch bite, wheelspin, lugging, gear,
chain, landing, full pull, chalk line
+slack_to_go_m(snapshot) : float, still to creep into the ready band
+build_label : Label, the build at the bottom
a tractor pulling the sled at sunset,
drawn to scale in 2D behind the menus;
tools/make_icons.gd draws the icons from it
which build this is, from res://build_info.cfg
draws the blended snapshot and hands the run the controls;
who pulls next and the standings are the event's (TractorPullEvent);
no physics or rules: TrackSpace only turns track
coordinates (x down the track, y left, z up) into Godot's
at the start and down the track:
green while the pull is good, red to stop
the easy or pro layout's controls
the engine heard on the track,
the phone vibrates in the pull
the cab camera, at the driver's eyes
headless, a scripted driver: the whole turn
from the bay to the sled and back
start, settings, practice, the event with its rivals,
the standings, next event; launched again:
